# `singlem prefilter-pad`

Create a prefilter FASTA where each on-target sequence is padded to a fixed length with the window in a consistent position (expert mode)

## Usage

**singlem** prefilter-pad \[-h\] --metapackage METAPACKAGE --output-fasta OUTPUT_FASTA \[--flank-length num_residues\] \[--debug\] \[--version\] \[--quiet\] \[--full-help\] \[--full-help-roff\]

## Options

**--flank-length** num_residues

number of flanking residues to include on each side of the window \[default: 30\]

### REQUIRED ARGUMENTS

**--metapackage** *METAPACKAGE*

Metapackage to read on-target sequences and window positions from

**--output-fasta** *OUTPUT_FASTA*

Padded prefilter FASTA to create

### OTHER GENERAL OPTIONS

**--debug**

output debug information

**--version**

output version information and quit

**--quiet**

only output errors

**--full-help**

print longer help message

**--full-help-roff**

print longer help message in ROFF (manpage) format
